summary:
Fixed and verified.

**The needle:** an off-by-one array-slice bug in `process_batch` (`processor.py:17`).

```python
end = start + batch_size - 1   # ❌ drops the last record of every batch
end = start + batch_size       # ✅
```

Python slices are end-exclusive, so `records[start:start + batch_size - 1]` only takes `batch_size - 1` items, silently dropping one record per batch. The fix makes `test.sh` pass — all records survive batch boundaries, exact and uneven divisions included.
